sentences.pinyin: Báilù nà tiān de zǎochén, tiānqì yǒudiǎnr liáng.
sentences.english: On the morning of White Dew, the weather was a bit cool.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì yīqǐ zǒujìn huāyuán.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili walked into the garden together.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì gāoxìng de shuō: "Gēge, kuài kàn! Yèzi shàng yǒu hěnduō liàngliàng de lùzhū!"
sentences.english: Lili happily said, "Brother, look! There are many shiny dewdrops on the leaves!"

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiàozhe shuō: "Zhēn piàoliang! Tāmen xiàng xiǎo zhēnzhū yīyàng!"
sentences.english: Xiaoming smiled and said, "How beautiful! They are like little pearls!"

sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai zǒu guòlái gàosù tāmen: "Jīntiān shì Báilù.
sentences.english: Grandma came over and told them, "Today is White Dew."

sentences.pinyin: Báilù dào le, qiūtiān jiù yuè lái yuè shēn le, tiānqì yě huì yuè lái yuè liáng.
sentences.english: With White Dew arriving, autumn is getting deeper, and the weather will get cooler and cooler.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐmen yào duō chuān yīfu, bié gǎnmào le."
sentences.english: You should wear more clothes, don't catch a cold."

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì wèn: "Nǎinai, wèishéme jiào 'Báilù' ne?"
sentences.english: Lili asked, "Grandma, why is it called 'White Dew'?"

sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai xiàozhe huídá: "Yīnwèi zǎoshang yèzi shàng de lùshuǐ shì báisè de, suǒyǐ jiào Báilù."
sentences.english: Grandma smiled and replied, "Because the dew on the leaves in the morning is white, it's called White Dew."

sentences.pinyin: Tīng le nǎinai de huà, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì huídào le jiā.
sentences.english: After hearing Grandma's words, Xiaoming and Lili went home.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng duì mèimei shuō: "Jiàoshījié kuài dào le, wǒ xiǎng sòng lǎoshī yīgè lǐwù."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said to his sister, "Teacher's Day is coming soon, I want to give the teacher a gift."

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ yǒu yīgè hǎo zhǔyì! Wǒmen yòng qiūtiān de yèzi zuò shūqiān kǎpiàn ba!"
sentences.english: Lili said, "I have a great idea! Let's make bookmarks and cards with autumn leaves!"

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng mǎshàng shuō: "Hǎo a! Wǒ qù jiǎn yèzi, nǐ lái xiězì."
sentences.english: Xiaoming immediately said, "Great! I'll go collect leaves, and you can do the writing."

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì kāixīn de shuō: "Tài hǎo le, jiù zhème bàn!"
sentences.english: Lili happily said, "That's great, let's do it!"

sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén yòu huídào huāyuán, jiǎn le hóngsè hé huángsè de yèzi.
sentences.english: The two of them went back to the garden and picked red and yellow leaves.

sentences.pinyin: Huí jiā yǐhòu, tāmen yīqǐ zuò hǎo le měilì de shūqiān kǎpiàn.
sentences.english: After returning home, they made beautiful bookmarks and cards together.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì zài kǎpiàn shàng xiě: "Lǎoshī, xièxie nín! Zhù nín Jiàoshījié kuàilè!"
sentences.english: Lili wrote on the card: "Teacher, thank you! Happy Teacher's Day!"

sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié nà tiān zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì bǎ kǎpiàn sòng gěi le lǎoshī.
sentences.english: On the morning of Teacher's Day, Xiaoming and Lili gave the card to their teacher.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī kàn le fēicháng gāoxìng, xiàozhe shuō: "Xièxie nǐmen! Zhè shì wǒ shōudào guò de zuì hǎo de lǐwù!"
sentences.english: The teacher was very happy to see it, and smiled, "Thank you! This is the best gift I have ever received!"

sentences.pinyin: Tīng le lǎoshī de huà, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì de xīnlǐ xiàng chī le táng yīyàng tián.
sentences.english: After hearing the teacher's words, Xiaoming and Lili felt as sweet as if they had eaten candy.
